title: Backend Updater
description: The mod needs its core files to function properly. You must download the base file package (backend) directly from GitHub to be able to install it in your games.
localFolderHint: Select the folder containing the matching backend’s Linux packages (.tar.gz or .zip) downloaded from the project, or the extracted 32 and/or 64 subfolders. Do not select the NVIDIA DLL or the .bin model.
localFolderPrompt: Select the folder with the backend’s Linux packages (.tar.gz/.zip) or 32 and/or 64 subfolders
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the mod files? They will need to be downloaded again to install in other games.
openFolderError: Could not open the mod folder.
